Name: Preventive Maintenance Scheduling
Action: I want to create and schedule preventive work orders on a recurring basis, linked to specific equipment units and maintainable items, based on calendar time intervals.
Benefit: So that I can ensure routine maintenance is executed on time according to the established plan, maintaining traceability in compliance with ISO standards and reducing the risk of failure due to omission.
Observations: This story is strictly restricted to scheduling by calendar time intervals.

Name: Digital WO Closure with ISO 14224 Taxonomy
Action: I want to record the closure of a work order from my mobile device, classifying the failure according to the ISO 14224 taxonomy and attaching multimedia evidence.
Applicable TRs: Offline-First Synchronization (https://app.notion.com/p/Offline-First-Synchronization-31887c56a828809a8488e98e3d269c2c?pvs=21), ISO 14224 Hierarchy Management and Validation (https://app.notion.com/p/ISO-14224-Hierarchy-Management-and-Validation-31887c56a828804aa78dd1f9efb140dd?pvs=21)
Benefit: So that I can ensure technical traceability, comply with industry standards, and allow accurate calculation of reliability indicators (MTBF/MTTR).
Observations: This process is critical to guarantee information quality according to ISO 14224 requirements. The implementation prioritizes an optimized user experience for mobile devices in the field, ensuring the capture of failure data (mode, mechanism, cause) even in low-connectivity conditions.

Name: Contractor Report Upload
Action: I want to upload my work report in digital format to the assigned work order.
Benefit: So that I can fulfill the client's delivery requirement quickly and digitally.
Observations: This component digitizes the delivery of third-party reports, unifying technical documentation in a single repository linked to the Work Order. The system must validate the integrity and format of the uploaded documents to ensure the information is actionable and secure, facilitating immediate review by the supervisor.

Name: Automatic Report Data Extraction
Action: I want the system to automatically extract key information from digital documents (actual hours, used spare parts, work description) and present it in a summary ready for validation.
Benefit: So that I can reduce the Work Order closure time and ensure traceability of technical maintenance data.
Observations: This cutting-edge functionality seeks to automate technical data ingestion through the cognitive processing of digital documents. Although extraction success is conditioned by the quality of the source reports, the system implements a mandatory human validation flow and a technical confidence indicator to ensure the integrity of the reliability database.

Name: Equipment Unit Technical Record Creation
Action: I want to create the digital technical record of a new physical equipment unit with its identification data and minimum operational parameters.
Benefit: So that I can have an official master record that allows life cycle traceability, linkage to maintenance plans, and the capture of failure history.
Observations: The creation of the Equipment Unit represents the digital formalization of the physical machine according to ISO 14224 Level 6. The system implements data integrity validations to ensure that each record has the technical and operational parameters necessary for its subsequent reliability management, guaranteeing the uniqueness of the industrial Tag throughout the plant's ecosystem.

Name: Inventory Movement Management
Action: I want to technically record the receipts, issues, and returns of critical materials and spare parts.
Benefit: So that I can maintain absolute integrity between the physical and digital inventory, guaranteeing the availability of materials for maintenance and the correct allocation of operational costs.
Observations: This functionality is critical for operational cost control and the traceability of the technical supply chain. The system implements transactional processes for receipts (Receipt), issues (Issue), and returns (Return), ensuring that inventory levels and cost allocation to work orders are accurate and auditable in real-time.

Name: New Equipment Unit Validation and Onboarding
Action: I want to technically review and complete the record of new equipment units in a preliminary state.
Benefit: So that I can guarantee that all engineering data, manuals, and hierarchical models are correct before authorizing the operational release and maintenance of the equipment unit.
Observations: This story defines the quality control point for the integrity of the master catalog. The technical validation flow guarantees that no equipment unit enters operation without having the minimum documentation required by ISO 14224, allowing the early detection of inconsistencies and ensuring a smooth transition between project and operation phases.

Name: Work Permit Layer Visualization
Action: I want to enable a visual layer showing active work permits on the 2D/3D Digital Twin.
Benefit: So that I can quickly identify dangerous crossings of activities and avoid accidents due to interference between contractors.
Observations: This functionality is critical for industrial safety (SIMOPS) and ISO 45001 compliance. Beyond the graphic representation, the system implements an integrity validation (Orphan Object Detection) that guarantees the exact correspondence between digital permits and physical equipment units in the digital twin, alerting to any inconsistency that could compromise personnel safety. The enriched 3D visualization requires plant connectivity; offline mode does not apply.

Name: Hierarchical Navigation and Semantic Zoom
Action: I want to zoom into a specific area of the plant using the mouse scroll.
Benefit: So that I can inspect the location of equipment units in dense areas in detail.
Observations: This story defines the advanced navigation and cinematic camera damping experience. The base rendering, panning, and dual zoom (geometric and semantic) functionality of the 2D canvas is guaranteed in the MVP through VIS-033 and UC-VIS-033. This story remains as SHOULD to govern high-fidelity camera transitions and volume limits.

Name: Exploded View Visualization
Action: I want to visualize the exploded view (breakdown) of the selected equipment unit in 3D.
Benefit: So that I can identify the exact location of an internal component before starting physical disassembly.
Observations: The exploded view represents an advanced visualization level to facilitate complex interventions. Due to its high demand for graphic resources and specialized modeling, it is classified as an optional functionality (COULD). Requires hierarchical 3D models available in the equipment repository; if the model is not available, the system must degrade gracefully without interrupting the main flow.

Name: Isolation Route (LOTO) and Active Lock Visualization
Action: I want to visualize the energy isolation route (LOTO) on the 2D/3D Digital Twin and have the system block the start of work if it detects active energy.
Benefit: So that I can ensure the intervention is performed under Zero Energy conditions, preventing occupational accidents.
Observations: This functionality constitutes the technological differentiator of the Digital Twin, combining graphic traceability of isolation points (Lockout/Tagout) with active lock logic that consumes sensor state telemetry. For the MVP, the IoT telemetry source will be an API simulator (mock) that emulates field data; the architecture is designed to replace this source with real hardware in later phases without rewriting the safety logic. This is documented as a proof of concept in the project's IEEE 830. Requires plant connectivity; offline mode does not apply.

Name: 3D Component Hierarchy Configuration
Action: I want to define the component hierarchy of an equipment unit (e.g., Pump -> Motor -> Bearing) and associate a 3D model with each level.
Applicable TRs: ISO 14224 Hierarchy Management and Validation (https://app.notion.com/p/ISO-14224-Hierarchy-Management-and-Validation-31887c56a828804aa78dd1f9efb140dd?pvs=21), HPHMI Philosophy (https://app.notion.com/p/HPHMI-Philosophy-31887c56a82880579232cd9889f07d5c?pvs=21)
Benefit: So that I can build the exploded view of the Digital Twin and allow technicians to access information on the specific component in the field.
Observations: This administrative tool allows granular configuration of the equipment hierarchy, facilitating the construction of the multilevel Digital Twin. The storage architecture must support high-density 3D models without penalizing performance when accessing the relational metadata of the equipment tree. Although the MVP will operate with a simplified initial structure, this functionality guarantees the long-term viability and scalability of the Digital Twin.

Name: Role and Permission Matrix Management (Industrial RBAC)
Action: I want to define user roles with a granular permission matrix (Create, Edit, Delete, Approve, Close, Audit).
Benefit: So that I can ensure the segregation of duties required by ISO 55001 and prevent the same user from requesting and approving critical actions.
Observations: This functionality is fundamental for system security and compliance with ISO 55001 (5.3), which requires authority and responsibility to be explicitly defined. In this phase, the base roles (Administrator, Planner, Technician, and Auditor) will be implemented with a granular permission matrix ensuring Segregation of Duties (SoD) and the principle of least privilege.

Name: User Management and Secure Life Cycle
Action: I want to manage the entire user life cycle (Create, Suspend, Restore, Reset Password) securely and auditably.
Benefit: So that I can protect access to the Digital Twin and ensure the traceability of actions performed by former employees.
Observations: Guaranteeing secure access is the first step toward system integrity. Following the ISO 55001 (7.2) standard, the entire user life cycle will be managed, including anti-brute force policies and secure password recovery. The logical deletion (soft-delete) policy is mandatory to preserve the complete history of the audit.

Name: ERP Integration Configuration (Simulation)
Action: I want to configure the API connection with a simulated ERP instance (Mock Server or Odoo).
Benefit: So that I can demonstrate the automatic synchronization of inventory data and ensure that technical requisitions triggered by equipment conditions are correctly converted into financial purchasing processes in the ERP.
Observations: To validate the industrial interoperability architecture under MIMOSA standards (OSA-EAI), a functional simulation will be implemented using a test server or an open-source instance. This will demonstrate the system's ability to synchronize inventory data with external platforms securely and scalably. Revision (2026-05-15) - Maintained as COULD for the MVP, focusing on compliance with ISO 27001 and the MIMOSA exchange standard.

Name: System Announcements Publishing
Action: I want to publish a global or role-based announcement.
Applicable TRs: Immutable Audit (https://app.notion.com/p/Immutable-Audit-31887c56a82880d393b1ddb5c150be69?pvs=21), RBAC Authentication and Authorization (https://app.notion.com/p/RBAC-Authentication-and-Authorization-31887c56a8288099b6e5f85f39da64f8?pvs=21)
Benefit: So that I can inform users about maintenance windows or other important platform news.
Observations: An internal communication system is implemented to notify users about operational events or maintenance windows. It is a user experience enhancement feature that facilitates change management and the dissemination of relevant technical information.

Name: Executive KPIs Dashboard
Action: I want to view an Executive Dashboard with key KPIs (MTBF, Costs, Availability) allowing filtering by date and area.
Benefit: So that I can identify failure trends and "Bad Actors" to direct the maintenance budget where it is needed most.
Observations: The executive dashboard synthesizes operational information for strategic budget and reliability decision-making. Based on ISO 14224 standards and MRO best practices (Wireman Vol 2), the system will allow the identification of trends and critical equipment units through efficient historical data processing.

Name: PDF Report Export
Action: I want to download a PDF report with key maintenance indicators (MTBF, MTTR, Availability).
Benefit: So that I can analyze monthly performance and present it in management meetings without depending on a system connection.
Observations: The PDF export capability responds to the need for offline analysis and presentation of results in management meetings. Priority will be given to a professional document design including KPI tables and trend charts, ensuring strategic information is accessible offline.

Name: Data Synchronization with BI Tools
Action: I want to export or synchronize KPI data directly with external tools (like Power BI or Excel).
Benefit: So that I can have management presentations always updated and perform deep analysis without having to manually copy and paste charts every month.
Observations: This integration facilitates deep data analysis by allowing the consumption of KPIs from external business intelligence tools. Through a secure programmatic interface, the system ensures strategic data is available for use in broader corporate ecosystems. Revision (2026-05-18) - Maintained as COULD prioritizing OpenAPI specification design and ISO 27001 assurance.

Name: Mobile Manuals Consultation
Action: I want to search and consult technical manuals and blueprints linked to the equipment hierarchy directly from the operational application.
Benefit: So that I can consult the necessary information at the repair site without having to travel to the office or look for physical folders, ensuring the documentation is relevant to the component I am intervening on.
Observations: This functionality seeks to decentralize access to technical information, allowing operational personnel to consult manuals and blueprints directly at the point of work. Although it is a significant productivity improvement for the conceptual prototype, its production implementation requires a robust document management strategy and an integrated document viewer with offline operation capabilities.

Name: Replenishment Monitor (Stock Alerts)
Action: I want to receive automatic notifications when inventory levels fall below the defined critical point, with prioritization based on the technical classification of spare parts.
Benefit: So that I can start purchasing processes in a timely manner and avoid interruptions in the availability of the plant's critical equipment.
Observations: This component implements intelligent inventory management based on ABC criticality. By automating the detection of critical stock levels, the system allows warehouse personnel to focus on high-impact spare parts (Class A), optimizing cash flow and reducing the risk of lost profits due to material unavailability.

Name: Optimization Suggestions (PMO)
Action: I want to see automatic suggestions on maintenance frequency based on the equipment unit's failure history.
Benefit: So that I can identify equipment being over-maintained and adjust the plan to reduce unnecessary costs.
Observations: Based on historical reliability analysis, the system will suggest maintenance plan optimizations to avoid over-maintenance. Although full implementation requires a robust historical database, it is defined as a key strategy for long-term cost efficiency. Revision (2026-05-18) - The implementation of predictive AI (Machine Learning) for maintenance suggestions would introduce critical schedule risk and require high-cost statistical computing infrastructure, deviating focus from AP6 core objectives.

Name: Usage or Telemetry-Based Preventive Maintenance Scheduling
Action: I want to schedule preventive work orders based on accumulated usage limits (hour meters or cycle counters) linked to the equipment unit's telemetry.
Applicable TRs: ISO 14224 Hierarchy Management and Validation (https://app.notion.com/p/ISO-14224-Hierarchy-Management-and-Validation-31887c56a828804aa78dd1f9efb140dd?pvs=21), Real-Time Synchronization (https://app.notion.com/p/Real-Time-Synchronization-31887c56a828809e859be1c2fbc2c55f?pvs=21)
Benefit: So that I can guarantee that critical equipment receives maintenance according to its actual wear and not just elapsed calendar time.
Observations: This story enables predictive/preventive maintenance based on the actual usage of the equipment unit. It consumes usage counter data (hour meters, cycles, gallons) that can be updated manually or through data ingestion from the auxiliary SCADA/IoT system.

Name: General System Configuration
Action: I want to configure global system parameters (e.g., Company Logo, Time Zone, Units of Measurement).
Benefit: So that I can customize the platform according to the plant's identity and location without modifying the code.
Observations: Allows the customization of operational and identity parameters of the system. The management of these global settings ensures the platform adapts to the regional environment and the organization's visual standards without requiring code-level changes. Revision (2026-05-18) - Dynamic parametrization of the graphical interface (Branding and custom UI/UX) requires front-end development load and state management (Theme Providers) that does not add direct value to the ISO 55001 management required for technical approval.

Name: Equipment Swap
Action: I want to unlink a physical equipment unit from its functional location and install an identical replacement equipment from the inventory.
Benefit: So that I can preserve the accumulated reliability history in the operational position, record the change of location of the physical machine, and update the state of rotable spare parts in a traceable manner.
Observations: Equipment Swap is a fundamental process in industrial maintenance management according to the ISO 14224 standard. It allows decoupling the maintenance history of the operational position (Functional Location, Level 5) from the physical equipment unit (Equipment Unit, Level 6), recording transitions to warehouse, workshop, or disposal states in an auditable manner.

Name: Backlog Management via Objective Prioritization (RIME)
Action: I want the system to automatically assign a RIME priority to tasks by combining equipment criticality and the selected work class.
Benefit: So that I can eliminate subjectivity in scheduling, ensure ISO 55001 compliance, and focus resources on the highest-impact interventions.
Observations: The system will calculate the RIME Score by delegating the operation to the configurable prioritization engine under the industrial RIME standard (according to the MVP strategy defined in ADR-002: Criticality × Work Class, range 1 to 100). Being a direct operation based on equipment master data and work type selection, sequential dependency with the inventory module is eliminated.

Name: Functional Locations Creation
Action: I want to define the hierarchical structure of the organization's functional locations, independently of the installed physical equipment units.
Benefit: So that I can have a master record of the operational positions that allows preserving the technical and maintenance history over time, even in the event of equipment replacement.
Observations: Functional Locations constitute the base architecture of the equipment tree according to ISO 14224. By decoupling the operational position from the physical equipment, the system allows the historical accumulation of reliability data on a specific process, guaranteeing long-term traceability and facilitating hierarchical navigation from the plant to the intervention point.

Name: AI Documentation Consultation Assistant (RAG)
Action: I want to make natural language queries about technical procedures and manuals integrated into the system.
Benefit: So that I can get fast answers with explicit references to a specific page/section of the manual, ensuring I confirm the information at the source before acting.
Observations: This innovation functionality seeks to reduce technical information search time by using RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architecture. By indexing the equipment's technical manuals, the system allows the technician to make contextual queries, ensuring each technical answer is backed by a direct reference to the manufacturer's documentation, thus minimizing operational risk due to interpretation errors.

Name: Equipment Physical Boundaries Definition
Action: I want to define and validate the physical boundaries of each master equipment unit, specifying its start, end points, and integrated internal components.
Benefit: So that I can ensure each equipment unit has clear physical boundaries (start/end + included components), preventing duplication of maintenance or incorrect failure allocation.
Observations: This functionality is a mandatory ISO 14224 requirement for reliability data integrity. The precise definition of Boundaries ensures the equipment hierarchy is unique and consistent, eliminating ambiguities in the allocation of costs and technical responsibilities between adjacent equipment units.

Name: Equipment Warranty Management
Action: I want to receive automatic notifications when an intervention is managed on an equipment unit with an active warranty.
Applicable TRs: ISO 14224 Hierarchy Management and Validation (https://app.notion.com/p/ISO-14224-Hierarchy-Management-and-Validation-31887c56a828804aa78dd1f9efb140dd?pvs=21), HPHMI Philosophy (https://app.notion.com/p/HPHMI-Philosophy-31887c56a82880579232cd9889f07d5c?pvs=21)
Benefit: So that I can leverage warranty coverage before performing internal maintenance, optimizing costs and avoiding redundant work on equipment still under warranty.
Observations: This functionality optimizes equipment return on investment (ROI) by automating the detection of active coverages. By integrating warranty dates with the work order creation flow, the system prevents unnecessary expenditure of internal resources and ensures compliance with external provider support contracts.

Name: Part Master Catalog Management
Action: I want to create and manage technical spare parts information, including their classification, taxonomy, and inventory policy.
Benefit: So that I can guarantee the existence of a single, standardized technical catalog that facilitates material planning and efficient control of critical stock.
Observations: The Part Master centralizes the technical knowledge of spare parts and operational supplies. Through the use of hierarchical product codes (Commodity Codes) and ABC classification, the system allows rigorous control of the technical supply chain, also implementing duplicate detection mechanisms to ensure the purity of the master catalog.

Name: Immutable Audit System
Action: I want to consult a chronological and unalterable record of all critical actions performed in the system (Creation, Modification, Deletion).
Benefit: So that I can reconstruct the sequence of events in the event of an incident and demonstrate regulatory compliance (ISO 55001 / ISO 14224).
Observations: Information integrity is a pillar of the ISO 55001 standard. The system will implement an unalterable audit log that allows the reconstruction of any incident. Secure persistence techniques and database-level integrity protection will be used to ensure each critical action is traceable, chronological, and protected against manipulation.

Name: Base Visualization and 2D Equipment Inspection
Action: I want to view the interactive plant layout and select specific equipment.
Benefit: So that I can consult its operational status, technical data, and real-time telemetry readings from a single graphical interface.
Observations: Constitutes the base canvas of the Digital Twin according to ADR-001. Allows loading the interactive map and linking geometries with physical equipment units for real-time telemetry reading, serving as a foundation for safety layers (LOTO and Permits). Requires plant connectivity to reflect SCADA data.
